title: Obtend
summary: OBTEND', verb transitive [Latin obtendo; ob and tendo; literally, to stretch against or before.] 1. To oppose; to hold out in opposition. 2. To pretend; to offer as the reason of any thing. [Not used.

inlines.v: OBTEND', verb transitive [Latin obtendo; ob and tendo; literally, to stretch against or before.] 1. To oppose; to hold out in opposition. 2. To pretend; to offer as the reason of any thing. [Not used. This word is rarely used.]
